source_name: Bolagsverket — Värdefulla datamängder (Valuable Datasets) API v1 — /organisationer (company base data)
license: Free of charge, no contract — EU Open Data Directive high-value datasets (2019/1024 / EU 2023/138); confirm exact reuse string on dataportal.se/datasets/612_5428
record_shape: single_json_object_per_organisationsnummer (POST request body carries the orgnr; response = company base-data object)
_observation_basis: NO authenticated record was observed. Both /isalive and /organisationer return HTTP 401 'Missing Credentials' (WSO2 OAuth2 gateway) without a token. Fields below are taken from the official source landing pages, the schema_notes.md mapping, and the community client library docs (bolagsverket_ex). Treat field names/types as documented-but-unverified until a credentialed pull confirms the exact JSON shape and casing.

fields.meaning: 10-digit Swedish organisation number; primary identifier of the legal entity. For sole traders this is the personnummer (personal identity number).
fields.limitations: Display form is NNNNNN-NNNN; the API may return digits-only or hyphenated form — confirm. For physical persons (enskild firma) this is a personnummer and is privacy-sensitive.
fields.analysis_notes: Canonicalize to digits-only (10) and keep a display form NNNNNN-NNNN. Example value 556012-5790 is a publicly known orgnr used only to illustrate format.

fields.meaning: Registered legal name of the organisation.
fields.limitations: Exact JSON key (organisationsnamn vs namn) unverified without a credentialed response. Historical/previous names may be a separate field or absent.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary display name. Derive a normalized_name downstream.

fields.meaning: Legal form of the entity, e.g. Aktiebolag (AB), Handelsbolag (HB), Kommanditbolag (KB), Enskild firma, Ekonomisk förening.
fields.code_list: Swedish legal-form codes (Bolagsverket); coded vs free-text representation unconfirmed
fields.limitations: May be returned as a code, a text label, or both. Exact key name and code list not verified.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to internal company_type. Keep both raw label and any code.

fields.meaning: Registration status of the entity, e.g. registered (registrerad), deregistered (avregistrerad), bankruptcy (konkurs), liquidation (likvidation).
fields.limitations: Exact enumeration and whether status is a single field or a set of flags/dates is unverified.
fields.analysis_notes: Map active/inactive plus a raw status label. Bankruptcy/liquidation are sub-states worth preserving.

fields.meaning: Industry classification code (Svensk näringsgrensindelning, SNI 2025) describing the principal activity.
fields.limitations: May be one primary code or several; secondary codes and a text description may or may not be returned. SCB is the more complete SNI source.
fields.analysis_notes: Treat as repeatable. Cross-check / enrich with SCB SNI which is documented per company and per workplace.

fields.meaning: Registered postal street address of the organisation.
fields.limitations: Address sub-structure (single string vs nested street/postnr/postort) unconfirmed. Field naming illustrative.
fields.analysis_notes: Postal/registered address; may differ from a visiting address. Keep raw sub-fields.

fields.meaning: Swedish postal code (postnummer) of the registered address.
fields.limitations: Spacing format (NNN NN) vs digits-only unconfirmed.
fields.analysis_notes: Normalize to 5 digits; keep display spacing.

fields.meaning: Postal town/locality of the registered address.
fields.limitations: Municipality (kommun) and county (län) are better sourced from SCB; the Bolagsverket payload may not break them out.
fields.analysis_notes: Use postort for locality; resolve kommun/län from SCB where possible.

fields.meaning: Date the entity was registered with Bolagsverket.
fields.limitations: Presence and exact key (registreringsdatum / registrering) unconfirmed; ISO YYYY-MM-DD expected.

fields.meaning: Date the entity was deregistered, if applicable.
fields.limitations: Only present for deregistered entities; exact key unconfirmed.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to dissolution_date; correlate with status.

fields.meaning: Swedish VAT number, format SE + 12 digits (organisationsnummer + 01), where the entity is VAT-registered.
fields.limitations: Whether VAT is returned by Bolagsverket or must be derived/obtained from SCB register flags is unconfirmed. VAT can be derived as SE+orgnr+01 but registration status is the authoritative signal.
fields.analysis_notes: Prefer an authoritative VAT/register flag (SCB) over a derived SE+orgnr+01 string; mark derived values.
